{"subject":"Claim C020577 past payer filing limit - write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C020577 (patient PT0282, service code T1005, 8 units, billed $38.40, date of service 2026-10-31) was submitted 61 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, so the payer is predicted to deny it as D03.

Editing the claim cannot fix this. I need a write-off decision on this claim from you. The visit (V004013, 121 minutes, verified) is documented, but the claim cannot be filed as it stands.

Please let me know your decision as soon as possible, since the claim is already past the filing limit and further delay will not help."}
